saints.name: Sts. Zachary and Elizabeth
saints.title: Parents of St. John the Baptist
saints.shortBlurb: The righteous priest and his wife, kinswoman of the Virgin Mary, who in old age became parents of the Baptist…
biography: Zachary was a priest of the course of Abia, and his wife Elizabeth was of the daughters of Aaron and a kinswoman of the Blessed Virgin Mary. The Gospel of Luke calls them both just before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments, yet childless and advanced in years.

To Zachary, ministering in the Temple, the angel Gabriel announced the birth of a son, John, forerunner of the Lord; struck dumb for his hesitation, he regained speech at the child's naming and sang the Benedictus. It was to Elizabeth, then with child, that Mary came in haste, and Elizabeth greeted her as the mother of her Lord. The Roman Martyrology commemorates them on this day.
saints.knownFor: The devout parents of St. John the Baptist.

sources.text: The Roman Martyrology (1914 English ed.; public domain)
